common.pageErrorBody: Something failed while loading Analytics. Your data is safe. Try again.
common.errorInvalid: That didn't work with those details. Check them and try again.

noProject.title: Create your first project
noProject.body: A project gets its own key and its own data. Create one for each site or app you want to measure, then paste the snippet.
noProject.bodyMember: This workspace has no Analytics projects yet. Ask an admin to create one.

web.title: Web analytics
web.error: We couldn't load web analytics. Try again.
web.noData: No pageviews yet. Paste the snippet on your site and visits show up here within seconds.
web.chartSummary: {visitors} visitors and {pageviews} pageviews in the period

events.title: Activity
events.description: Events as they arrive. New ones show up at the top every few seconds.
events.error: We couldn't load new events. Retrying.
events.empty: No events yet. Install the snippet or send one from your server and it shows up here.

result.noData: No data for this query in the selected period.
result.dropped: {count, plural, one {# person dropped off} other {# people dropped off}}
result.truncated: The query read the maximum number of rows (200,000). Narrow the date range for an exact result.
result.pathsSessions: {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} with pageviews.
result.sqlRows: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} in {ms} ms

editor.pathsNote: Paths follow pageviews within each session. They show the most common next page at each step.
editor.name: Name
editor.runHint: Run the query to see results.

errors.request_failed: The query didn't run. Try again.
errors.invalid_query: Something in the definition isn't valid. Check the events and filters.
errors.rate_limited: Too many queries in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to Analytics in this workspace.
errors.too_long: The query is too long (10,000 characters max).
errors.quoted_identifiers_not_allowed: Quoted identifiers aren't allowed. Use plain names.
errors.must_start_with_select: Queries start with SELECT or WITH.
errors.keyword_not_allowed: That keyword isn't allowed: queries are read-only
errors.table_not_allowed: Only the tables events, persons, person_distinct_ids and sessions are available
errors.unterminated_string: A string is missing its closing quote.
errors.invalid_character: The query has a character that isn't allowed
errors.sql_timeout: The query took too long (8 seconds max) and was stopped. Add filters or a shorter time range.
errors.join_without_condition: Each JOIN needs ON or USING, and FROM can’t list tables with commas.
errors.too_many_tables: A query reads at most two tables (counting each use of a WITH), and two only through one JOIN by key.
errors.join_not_allowed: Joins only go between two tables by their key: events.person_id = persons.id, events.distinct_id = person_distinct_ids.distinct_id, events.session_id = sessions.id, person_distinct_ids.person_id = persons.id or sessions.distinct_id = person_distinct_ids.distinct_id. Extra conditions go with AND.
errors.sql_busy: Too many SQL queries are running right now. Try again in a few seconds.

sql.title: SQL
sql.description: Read-only SQL over this project's events, people and sessions (SQLite syntax).
sql.help: Tables: events (last 90 days, the newest 100,000), persons, person_distinct_ids, sessions. Read properties with json_extract(properties, '$.plan'). Timestamps are milliseconds. At most two tables, joined by key with ON. Up to 1,000 rows and 8 seconds. Run with ⌘ Enter.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: Saved trends, funnels, retention, paths and SQL queries for this project.
insights.emptyBody: Build a trend, a funnel or a retention table and save it to find it here and add it to dashboards.
insights.name: Name
insights.deleteBody: The insight is deleted and leaves every dashboard it's on. The events stay.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Groups of saved insights you check together.
dashboards.emptyBody: Create a dashboard and add saved insights to it.
dashboards.name: Name
dashboards.deleteBody: The dashboard is deleted. Its insights stay in the list.
dashboards.tileEmptyBody: Add saved insights with the menu at the top.
dashboards.tileEmptyBodyNoInsights: Save an insight first, then add it here.

persons.title: People
persons.description: Everyone who sent events, with their properties and timeline.
persons.dropped: {count, plural, one {# person who dropped off the funnel} other {# people who dropped off the funnel}}.
persons.search: Search by distinct ID, email or property
persons.error: We couldn't load people. Try again.
persons.emptyBody: People show up when their first event arrives. Call identify() to link them to your user IDs.
persons.deleteBody: The person, their distinct IDs, sessions and every event they sent are erased. This can't be undone. Events they send later create a new person.

cohorts.title: Cohorts
cohorts.description: Groups of people by their properties or by what they did. Use them to filter insights.
cohorts.emptyBody: Create a cohort, such as people who viewed the pricing page three times this month.
cohorts.name: Name
cohorts.deleteBody: Insights filtered by this cohort stop working until you pick another one. People and events stay.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Turn features on for some people, a percentage of them or by variant.
flags.keyHelp: Letters, numbers, - and _. Your code uses this key.
flags.emptyBody: Create a flag to release a feature gradually or to a group of people.
flags.name: Name
flags.deleteBody: Code that checks this flag gets no value (undefined) from now on.
flags.conditionsHelp: Only people whose properties match every condition. Without conditions, everyone is eligible.

errors.duplicate_key: Another flag already uses that key.
errors.variants_must_sum_100: Variants have to add up to 100%.
errors.invalid_input: Check the key: letters, numbers, - and _ only.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Each project has its own key and its own data. Use one per site or app.
projects.descriptionMember: Projects of this workspace. Admins create and delete them.
projects.emptyBody: Create a project to get a key and start sending events.
projects.name: Name
projects.deleteBody: The key stops accepting events right away and all of the project's data is erased. This can't be undone.

settings.title: Install and settings
settings.installDesc: Paste this before </head>. It captures pageviews, and clicks, field changes and form submits if autocapture is on.
settings.publicKey: Public project key (safe to put in your site)
settings.apiHelp: API: zs.capture(event, properties), zs.identify(id, properties), zs.alias(id), zs.group(type, key, properties), zs.register(properties), zs.reset(), zs.isFeatureEnabled(key), zs.getFeatureFlag(key), zs.onFeatureFlags(callback). Add the class zs-no-capture to an element to skip it.
settings.serverDesc: The same endpoint takes batches of up to 200 events with the secret key. The secret key skips the allowed-domains check: never put it in a browser.
settings.secretOnce: Copy the secret key now. It won't be shown again.
settings.settingsDesc: What the snippet captures and how long data is kept.
settings.adminsOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
settings.name: Project name
settings.autocapture: Autocapture clicks, field changes and form submits
settings.autocaptureHelp: Field values are never captured. Text that looks like an email or a long number is dropped.
settings.respectDnt: Respect Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control
settings.anonymizeIp: Anonymize IP addresses (keep only the network part)
settings.domainsHelp: One per line, such as example.com or *.example.com. With a list, the public key only works from those sites. Empty means any site.
settings.timezoneHelp: Days and weeks in insights start at midnight in this offset. It doesn't follow daylight saving time.
settings.deleteDesc: The key stops accepting events right away. Events, people, insights, dashboards, cohorts and flags of the project are erased.
